tagline: A dynamic, data-driven platform where users can explore Africa, drill into communities, and see real-time progress of holistic transformation.
subtitle: Explore Africa → Understand Communities → Measure Transformation

hierarchy.title: Geographic structure
hierarchy.description: The platform mirrors how PA organises ministry on the ground — from continent to community.

levels.label: Country
levels.description: National pastor networks and country-level coordination

levels.label: Catchment Area
levels.description: 3–5 communities grouped for coordinated pastor leadership

levels.label: Community
levels.description: A local area led by a pastor leader on a 2-year transformation journey

levels.label: Shalom Groups
levels.description: 30–50 leaders per community in discipleship and cohesion groups

pillars.title: Catchment Areas
pillars.description: Pastor leaders coordinate transformation across a cluster of neighbouring communities — the bridge between country strategy and community action.

pillars.title: Shalom Groups
pillars.description: Each community develops Shalom groups of 30–50 leaders who drive discipleship, cohesion, and local initiative.

pillars.title: 2-Year Transformation Journey
pillars.description: Every community progresses through a structured two-year journey from Awareness to Multiplication — tracked in the community tracking system.

pillars.title: Community-Led Development
pillars.description: Pastor-Planned Projects (PPPs) and Church-initiated Projects (CHIPs) are community-owned initiatives — water, agriculture, livelihood, and more.

pillars.title: Triple-A Leadership
pillars.description: Pastor leaders develop through Awareness (vision), Ability (skills), and Action (implementation) — measured via leadership scores and engagement.

pillars.title: Resource Mobilization
pillars.description: Communities mobilise local resources and partnerships. The platform tracks mobilization to guide where support is most needed.

stages.label: Implementation
stages.description: PPP & CHIP projects active; measurable outcomes

tripleA.title: Triple-A Leadership Model
tripleA.description: How pastor leaders grow through the transformation journey.

dimensions.label: Awareness
dimensions.description: Vision for holistic community transformation; understanding the journey framework

dimensions.label: Ability
dimensions.description: Skills in leadership, discipleship, facilitation, and programme delivery

dimensions.label: Action
dimensions.description: Implementing PPPs, mobilizing Shalom groups, and driving measurable community outcomes

points.label: Shows real data
points.description: Field tracking data feeds dashboards — not just stories and photos

points.label: Tracks real progress
points.description: Journey stages, leadership scores, and project outcomes updated regularly

points.label: Connects geography to impact
points.description: Africa → Country → Catchment → Community — drill down to see where work happens

points.label: Enables analysis
points.description: Trends, comparisons, CBC index, and readiness levels for informed decisions

items.description: Scorecards, catchment dashboards, and trend analysis for strategic decisions
Reports, case studies, and live data that verify ministry outcomes
Stories connected to metrics — see exactly where investment makes a difference
A shared intelligence layer aligned with how PA actually works on the ground
